summary.en: Pure-Lua date, time, formatting, and time zone helpers built around normalized timetable objects.
summary.zh: 围绕标准化 timetable 对象提供日期、时间、格式化与时区能力的纯 Lua 工具包。

en: The upstream `tzcache` implementation assumes IANA zoneinfo files such as `/usr/share/zoneinfo` and `/etc/localtime`.
zh: 上游 `tzcache` 实现默认假定存在 IANA zoneinfo 文件路径，例如 `/usr/share/zoneinfo` 与 `/etc/localtime`。
